title: Tiny Engine Cadet — Fuel Oil Purifier
technical_truth: A fuel oil purifier removes water and solid impurities from fuel oil by centrifugal separation so cleaner fuel can be supplied to the engine.
interview_question: Interview question: What is the purpose of a fuel oil purifier?
